violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by a container. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Employee moved container during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026
The tile floor by the three bay sink had areas of low grout. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/28/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of debris. The front plate of the ice machine was cleaned at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/05/2024
